d: German footballer Jamal Musiala's future at Bayern Munich has become a talking point after senior club figures publicly questioned his contract and whether he can return to his best after a difficult spell with injuries and health problems. The comments have drawn criticism from FIFPRO, while club captain Joshua Kimmich has also questioned the way the situation has been handled. Rupha Ramani looks at the Bayern Munich controversy and asks whether the club has forgotten the person behind the player.
